test_title: PYST 9: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/192e14af9e5d91495b8dc93347acf215716a2c877bef9e70f36ed9f8171455cd.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately top left corner element, center element and bottom left corner element shifts in the clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately top center element, top right corner element and bottom right corner element shifts in the clockwise direction. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a316f669bc20c1b8ab419d52a9dab9957eefc91e9684b03289c0a43e35b1da79.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately top left corner and top right corner element interchange position.
 
• Alternately top center element shifts to center position. 
 
• Alternately bottom left corner element shifts to right corner position.
 
• Alternately bottom right corner element shifts to top center position.
 
• Alternately center element shifts to bottom left corner positon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c128d5045211ee1abb08d13e8f2855bd5b69d6b6e6594c0300bd297e41d67c7d.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c88975fc4ce2946836216bdc1d40c85dfe47c208a4b23a4ba90ccf9e01818ea.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (4)’ is the correct answer.
